title: Hot PPI Inflation Shocks Markets: Tech Rebounds Off Lows
speaker: Drew Dosek (Verified Investing)

macro_themes.view: PPI nearly doubled forecasts, yet the 10-year yield collapsed, which relieved pressure on stocks and gold.
Spillover from Asia (Kospi tanked) and concern about AI capex companies' ability to service debt capped the rally; memory names were hit.
Rising oil adds pressure and could push the 10-year back up, so expects index consolidation within the range.

calls.condition: Safe near term unless SPY closes under 766.17; a daily close above 781.60 makes a push to 800 near-certain
calls.reason: SPY held the trend-line support he flagged; still in a bullish consolidation since August; weekly looks like consolidation.
calls.quote: I imagine it's almost a guarantee once we get a close over $781, we're going to be pressing up there to the $800 mark

calls.condition: Favors upside as long as QQQ stays above the inverse head-and-shoulders neckline
calls.reason: Nasdaq reclaimed its declining breakout trend line; QQQ closed above the inverse H&S neckline after testing below it, measured move 806; IXIC could curl up to tag the rising trend line near 27,000.
calls.quote: that does also come with a targeted measured move up here at 806. Thus, you can see why I'm still favoring a little bit more upside

calls.condition: If SMH gets back above the 50% area of the parallel channel, it could march to the top of the channel at 597.69
calls.reason: Gapped well below support but selling lasted only 30 minutes and it closed near the high, a change of character from the string of bear flags.
calls.quote: It's telling me we're already knocking on the door to go higher at least near term

calls.reason: 'Sleeper hold' pattern on daily and weekly foreshadowed the reversal; yield collapsed after a big upper wick.
calls.quote: here I was saying I was going to be optimistic if we had price action on the 10-year trading back to the 5.021%... a very real possibility in the coming days

calls.condition: If yields start creeping back up, support could break and push gold back to the ~3,900 pivot lows
calls.reason: Falling yields relieved pressure and gold bounced, but it remains in bearish consolidation on top of support.
calls.quote: this level could break, and that could push us back down to these low pivots at $3,900

calls.reason: Weaker than gold; breaking the 50% area of a channel dating to 2008 with an active head-and-shoulders, measured move 53.26 where buyers should step in.

calls.reason: Oil pushing higher; next stop is the 50% area of its parallel channel.
